title: Speaking — Drawing and design
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on drawing and design.

questions: What do you usually do before leaving home?
At what time of day do you feel most alert?
Which part of your routine would you like to change?
Does your routine change during holidays?
Did you enjoy drawing when you were younger?
Where do you notice good design in daily life?

part2.topic: Describe something you designed for a practical purpose.
part2.closing: and explain why the design suited its purpose.

questions: What is the value of teaching design to students who are not artistic?
How do designers balance visual appeal with ease of use?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to drawing and design?
